svg.title: tengu-cluster architecture — the chat turn, its stores and key mechanics, and the flows without a user message: tengu run, tengu backtest, tengu ranking run (2026-04-27, cut to flows 2026-10-24)
svg.desc: Five stacked sections: the seven-step per-turn flow; the stores (Open Brain, LLM Wiki, planner files, runtime state); key mechanics; the two flows without a user message (tengu run: feed to tool to store to loop to exec tool to gate to ledger, and tengu backtest: market.db to resolve and prepare to candidates to the optional Jev gate to evaluate to the run dir); and tengu ranking run, from a sealed contract to a published ranking. Where each file lives: docs/code-map.html, generated from the source.
svg.text: tengu-cluster — how a user message becomes a response, and what runs without one
Single-page architecture walkthrough · 2026-04-27 · cut to flows + stores 2026-10-24 · companion to docs/architecture.md and .html · files: docs/code-map.html
section 1 - per-turn flow - the seven steps from prompt to reply

g.text: loads the registry, runs the planner LLM
child process, IPC over stdin/stdout JSON, kill on drop, step_timeout_secs
session_id · step_id · sandbox_config · plan_state · compose · TENGU_EGRESS env
load [agents.<name>] from the sandbox config, build PluginToolExecutor
outbound/tools/ catalog + mcp_client/ · claude_code, codex: tengu mcp-bridge
runs until the model calls compress_and_store OR max_turns (= limits.max_tool_rounds)
outbound/egress.rs - Tor proxy, host allowlist, shell sandbox, audit
Open Brain Postgres with postgres_memory; otherwise only over IPC

svg.text: step output flows back to the DagExecutor; replan when a step is exhausted

g.text: if memory.cross_session_msg_top_k is more than 0: semantic search over Open Brain memory,
injected as a "Cross-session message recall" block
writes the user message to Open Brain Postgres with session_id
also pushes to the in-memory ring buffer (lite, this process only)
within_session_output_top_k more than 0: recall of this session's step outputs
At step 5 startup (parent to child IPC):
SubprocessRunner forwards sandbox_config + plan_state: the child loads the same config
writes the step summary to Open Brain Postgres tagged with step_id
section 2 - stores - Open Brain, LLM Wiki, planner files, runtime state
root roster: agents + skills + tool defs
loaded into the planner prompt directly
no vector DB dependency for routing
the plan: to each step as IPC plan_state
Open Brain memory - who said what
stores user messages keyed by session_id
no TTL sweep yet (tracked in SESSION_HANDOFF)
Open Brain step outputs - what we did
default store for cross-plan recall on replan
compress_and_store is IMPLICIT on every subagent
child writes when the LLM calls it (or at exit)
also within-session recall on the next turn
outside every fs root; tengu prune spares it
section 3 - key mechanics - what surprised me reading this code
A. Doctrine: LLM = heart, Open Brain + LLM Wiki = brain, tools = hands
Planner does ONE thing - pick the right agent. It uses the orchestrator SKILL.md as its system prompt;
PlannerLlm::call sends one message: no tools, executor, bridge or memory. Subagents do the work in
their own subprocess. Strict boundary: the planner reasons over a roster, a subagent executes a step.
The caller resolves the id once (resolve_session_id: TENGU_SESSION_ID env override or a fresh UUID;
tengu webhooks mints webhook-<name>-<uuid> per request) and build_orchestrator hands the same
string to RegistryPlanner AND SubprocessRunner, so planner messages and subagent step summaries share
one key; run-agent exports it as TENGU_SESSION_ID for memory writes.
C. Sandbox config crosses the IPC boundary (Phase 7.2)
Without this, the child loaded ~/.tengu/config.toml and lost the parent's sandbox-specific scopes.
Symptom: http_request scope-denies in researcher while the parent's sandbox allows "*".
Fix: AgentIpcInput.sandbox_config, threaded from Config.sandbox_name to SubprocessRunner to IPC;
the child's egress comes from TENGU_EGRESS (the parent's resolved policy).
D. compress_and_store is implicit, not declared
Never list compress_and_store in [agents.*].tools - the runner appends it to every subagent. It marks
"I am done with this step." The middle-ground protocol: only fail when no text was emitted AND
no compress_and_store was called; otherwise OK with a tracing warn. A Claude Code step's bridge
writes the summary to TENGU_BRIDGE_SUMMARY_FILE, then the engine ends the CLI run.
E. Recall layers in the planner prompt
In-memory ring buffer (Phase 6.4 lite) - recent user messages of THIS process, lost on restart.
Cross-session block (Phase 6.4 full) - recall over Open Brain memory, survives restart, opt-in via
memory.cross_session_msg_top_k. Both inject before the current turn. A third opt-in lane,
within_session_output_top_k, recalls this session's step outputs.
F. C to B fallback - composed agents, two turns
Turn 1 (C): planner emits Direct asking the user to confirm the closest match.
Turn 2 (B): on confirmation, planner emits Plan with Step.compose set.
Runner loads the base agent, OVERRIDES skills + tools for this run only (config on disk unchanged);
in a hardened sandbox ([risk] / Solana signer) compose may only narrow the base.
L. Money paths fail closed inside the tool (2026-09-30)
The [risk] gate is not a planner or loop step: it runs inside every exec tool, so a feed, a Jev loop,
a bridged Claude Code call and tengu tool call hit the same check. Gate + fill + ledger write = one
BEGIN IMMEDIATE; idempotent per client_order_id (arg, else call id - never random); only a private
agent may hold an exec tool; an entry re-probes the kill-switch file inside the transaction.
M. Time is a port; history is read as-of (2026-10-01)
Clock: SystemClock live (feed schedules, paper fill latency), SimClock in replay - the backtest gate
runs the real DecisionLoop with its clock set to each decided_at; the decision cache makes reruns
identical (--offline). The engine reads series only as-of t: a bar is observable at its close, and
every trade records data_asof_ms ≤ decided_at_ms (checks.rs perturbs everything after t).
G. Context/token metrics observability (2026-04-28) - domain/metrics.rs + application/metrics.rs
Every successful planner, run-agent turn, embedding and Jev call emits one MetricsRecord, kind in {Planner, Subagent, Embedding, WikiCompiler, Decision}: tokens, latency,
prompt chars/bytes, and (for Planner) a per-context-layer breakdown (system / roster / cross_session / history / session_recall / recall / failure / user_message).
Three surfaces: tracing baseline (RUST_LOG=tengu=info, always on), in-process broadcast bus (OrchestratorEvent::MetricsRecorded, re-broadcast from the global sink),
TUI bottom bubble (TENGU_TUI_METRICS=1, opt-in). Failed calls and in-process chat turns (no plan) emit none.
emit_planner_metrics - AgentIpcOutput.metrics - embedder reads usage.total_tokens - decision loop: MetricsKind::Decision
section 4 - other flows - no user message: tengu run and tengu backtest
A. tengu run --sandbox <s> - feed → tool → store → loop → exec tool → gate → ledger (docs/runtime.md)
a tool feed may call an exec tool directly (xm_exits, xm_weekend_fade): clock work, no LLM, no Jev
health: run-<s>.json + loop/1 + feed/1 rows every heartbeat_secs → tengu doctor --sandbox <s> --live (tengu run healthcheck) · SIGINT / SIGTERM drain ≤ shutdown_grace_secs · a second runner exits 1

today: tool feeds only in xmarket, xmarket-weekend, xlab-w2 (history refresh + rankings); a job feed in soe (soe_cycle); Jev loops in lping (incl. exec chains), jev-exec, xlab / xlab-w2 (xl_gate), control-loop-lab (demo)
B. tengu backtest --sandbox <s> - market.db → resolve / prepare → candidates → [Jev gate] → evaluate → run dir (docs/xlab-2026-10-01.md)
without --gate: rules arms only - also what the backtest tool runs (a split's holdout hidden until holdout: true)
time integrity: a bar is observable at its close; series are read only as-of t; every trade records data_asof_ms ≤ decided_at_ms (domain/backtest/checks.rs perturbs everything after t)
section 5 - strategy ranking - tengu ranking run (2026-10-08)
tengu ranking run --sandbox <s> - sealed contract → date → lease → backtests → rank → publish (docs/ranking.md)
callers: tengu ranking run | show (cli/ranking.rs) · tool strategy_ranking (tools/xlab/rank.rs): xlab-w2's ranking feeds under tengu run (agent xl_ranker) · no LLM, no network, never a holdout read
This picture shows flows and stores, not file lists. Every module with its line count and first doc paragraph: docs/code-map.html (generated from the source).
One animated page per feature: docs/tutorial/ · the narrative with every step's files: docs/architecture.md · trace one turn first: tengu chat --sandbox lping, "what is the BTC price?".
